ev.q: 38 cases of SARS-CoV-2 infection were identified; the minimum attack rate was 30.2%
70.4% (38 of 54) of tests had a positive result
An estimated 1,700 in-person school days were lost
attack rates were highest among household members (30.0%)
Local public health officials in the three counties initiated an investigation

methods_quotes.q: Using the date of specimen collection for cases and exposure date for contacts, the number of missed days of school was calculated
Among these 446 contacts, five had received a diagnosis of COVID-19 during June–November and were excluded from attack rate calculations.
